Use any SystemOne server

Source: R/deciders.R
decider_systemone.Rd

Makes a decider for a server that speaks SystemOne, for example Clef-Flash on an SGLang server or Laya on laya-serve, often on the computer of the user.

Usage

decider_systemone(
  base_url,
  model,
  image_format = c("assets", "images"),
  credentials = NULL,
  input = NULL
)

Arguments

base_url

The server root, for example "http://localhost:30000". Requests go to <base_url>/v1/systemone.

model

The model name, for example "Cloudflare/clef-flash", or a Laya checkpoint ("english", "multilingual", "typed-decisions"). Required.

image_format

How the server takes images: "assets" (the SystemOne assets object) or "images" (an ordered list of images, as the SGLang server of Clef-Flash needs).

credentials

A function with no arguments that returns a key. NULL (the default) sends no key, as a local server needs none. A hosted SystemOne server can need one: give a function, and the key goes in an Authorization: Bearer header. For more control, the function can read the key from a secret store.

input

The input type that the model reads: "text", "image" or "text+image". NULL (the default) takes it from the internal table of input types; a model that is not in the table is not checked. decide() stops before any request when an input does not fit.

Value

A decider object for decide(). It holds no key.

Details

A local server such as Laya or Clef-Flash needs no key and no account. A hosted SystemOne server can need a key: give it with credentials.

With image_format = "images", decide() writes every image with three color channels, because the SGLang server cannot read a JPEG with one channel.

See also

Other deciders: decider_foundry(), decider_openai(), decider_openrouter(), decider_typesafe()

Examples

decider_systemone(
  "http://localhost:30000", "Cloudflare/clef-flash", image_format = "images"
)
#> <decider> The server at http://localhost:30000
#> * Model: Cloudflare/clef-flash
#> * URL: http://localhost:30000/v1/systemone
#> * Request format: systemone_images
#> * Input: text+image
decider_systemone("http://localhost:8000", "typed-decisions")
#> <decider> The server at http://localhost:8000
#> * Model: typed-decisions
#> * URL: http://localhost:8000/v1/systemone
#> * Request format: systemone
#> * Input: text
